observations.proposition: SK hynix announced a West Lafayette advanced-packaging and R&D facility, targeting next-generation HBM mass production in the second half of 2028.
observations.source_locator: release body, investment and planned mass-production paragraphs
observations.effective_scope: SK hynix West Lafayette project; announcement-era plan, not current operating status

observations.proposition: Micron reported starting volume production of 24GB 8H HBM3E for NVIDIA H200; H200 shipments were expected in calendar Q2 2024.
observations.source_locator: opening paragraph and paragraph on 36GB sampling
observations.effective_scope: Micron 24GB 8H HBM3E; no factory-specific output quantity established

observations.proposition: Micron planned March 2024 sampling of 36GB 12-high HBM3E. This announcement does not establish completed sampling or volume production.
observations.source_locator: opening paragraph and paragraph on 36GB sampling

observations.proposition: TSMC planned 2nm and 3nm production at its second Arizona fab beginning in 2028.

observations.proposition: Amkor and TSMC signed an MOU for packaging and testing at a planned Peoria facility serving Phoenix fabs. Specific technologies, including InFO and CoWoS, remained to be jointly defined.

observations.effective_scope: Amkor Peoria and TSMC Phoenix; MOU scope, not commissioned or qualified production
